The file lists the vortex centres (nm) seen in a model image of the Abrikosov vortex lattice of a type-II superconductor in a perpendicular magnetic field. Model conditions: the only measured input is the applied magnetic field (50.8 G = 5.08 mT) reported by Cottet et al. (arXiv:1401.4062; MgB2, cryo-Lorentz TEM at 5 K); the vortices form an ideal triangular lattice with exactly one superconducting flux quantum per vortex, no pinning disorder, lattice defects or thermal motion, and a uniform field, which is the idealization the paper compares its images with; the map is a finite patch of about 97 vortices in an arbitrary orientation. Each vortex carries one superconducting flux quantum Φ0 = h/(2e) = 2.0678 × 10⁻¹⁵ Wb. What is the magnetic induction B inside the superconductor that produces this lattice, in mT?

选项：
A. 1.693 mT
B. 2.540 mT
C. 4.399 mT
D. 5.080 mT

附件：vortex-MgB2-508G.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文实测磁场（或实测晶格常数）构建的理想三角涡旋晶格模型（约 97 个涡旋，确定性旋转）；不是实测涡旋位置。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
